# MKS’ Atotech to showcase advanced PCB and package substrate solutions at TPCA Show and IMPACT Conference 2026


**Berlin, October 15** **, 2026** – MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKS), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, today announced that its strategic brands Atotech, offering process chemicals, equipment, software and services, and ESI, providing laser systems, will showcase advanced manufacturing solutions for printed circuit boards (PCBs) and package substrates at TPCA Show 2026. The event will take place at the TaiNEX Center in Taipei, Taiwan, from October 20 to 22, 2026.


**Enabling next-generation** **electronics** **manufacturing**


The next phase of PCB manufacturing is defined by more than just design capability; it is also defined by the ability to reproduce advanced structures in large quantities with a stable yield and reliable performance. As high-layer-count multilayer and HDI PCBs transition to finer features, thinner dielectrics, and tighter assembly margins, achieving manufacturing consistency becomes paramount. In these circumstances, surface condition, seed layer and copper deposit quality, as well as final finish stability directly affect production yield and downstream performance.


As AI and HPC architectures increase interconnect density, bandwidth, and power delivery demands, PCB manufacturers must supply more advanced high-layer-count multilayers, HDI, substrate-like PCBs, and package substrates that meet tighter consistency requirements. In that environment, manufacturing becomes a determining factor in whether next-generation interconnect structures can be produced with acceptable yield, reliability, and assembly performance.


At TPCA Show 2026, MKS will present integrated surface treatment, laser processing, metallization, plating and final finishing chemicals and systems technologies for high-density PCBs, advanced package substrates, optical modules and next-generation packaging architectures.


By integrating MKS’ ESI laser systems with Atotech’s advanced chemistry and plating equipment, MKS delivers a comprehensive, one-stop solution for electronics manufacturing. This unified approach combines optimized laser drilling, plating, and surface modification chemistries with state-of-the-art equipment – enabling seamless pre-treatment, via formation, plating, and final finishing.


This innovative approach results in improved yields, enhanced productivity, and superior performance – all without production interruptions.


“As AI, high-performance computing, and advanced packaging reshape the electronics industry, the challenge is no longer simply creating smaller features or denser interconnects, but manufacturing increasingly sophisticated structures reliably, consistently, and at scale. Industry leadership depends not only on design innovation, but on controlling every critical interface across surface preparation, metallization, copper deposition, and finishing. As the boundaries between semiconductors, substrates, packaging, and PCBs blur, the reliability and efficiency of tomorrow’s AI infrastructure will increasingly depend on an integrated approach that optimizes materials, chemistry, equipment, and process control as a complete manufacturing ecosystem.” **Dave Henry** , Executive Vice President & GM of Materials Solutions Division, MKS.


In 2026, MKS’ Atotech is driving innovation in advanced electronics manufacturing through strategic investments in its Asia-based technology centers. These enhancements accelerate development for next-gen package substrates and support high-end SAP applications with line/space requirements of ≤5/5µm.


“In partnership with industry leaders, MKS\` Atotech is advancing technology for substrate-like PCBs, advanced high-layer count HDI and multilayer for AI PCBs and optical modules. By bringing together expertise in materials, chemistry, and systems technologies, we are enabling the next generation of electronics while driving innovation, performance, and manufacturing integration across the industry,” said **Harald Ahnert** , Senior Vice President and General Manager of Chemistry at MKS’ Materials Solutions Division.


**Bonding enhancement: Improving signal integrity without compromising adhesion**


AI, high-performance computing, and high-frequency applications demand strong copper-to-dielectric adhesion with minimal surface roughness, to address rising data throughput requirements. MKS\` Atotech addresses this challenge with its I/L bonding portfolio, including **BondFilm® HF** , **BondFilm® EX** , and **NovaBond® PX-S2** . These solutions are designed to provide reliable bonding while limiting copper roughness and line-width distortion, helping reduce conductor loss and preserve circuit geometry. By supporting low-loss dielectric materials, the portfolio helps PCB, HDI, and package-substrate manufacturers improve signal integrity while maintaining the adhesion required for reliable next-generation electronics.


**Desmear and metallization: Building a reliable foundation**


Reliable interconnect formation begins with high-quality desmear and metallization. As vias become smaller and dielectric materials more diverse, consistent metallization is critical to ensuring long-term performance and yield. MKS’ Atotech metallization solutions are engineered to deliver uniform coverage, strong throwing power, and defect-free copper deposition across advanced substrates, HDI designs, and AI-driven PCB architectures. The **Printoganth® MV TP3** family supports ultra-thin electroless copper deposition and, when combined with the innovative **G-Plate®** platform, enables advanced particle control for high-volume manufacturing. **Printoganth® P2** is designed for demanding AI, HDI, and multilayer board applications, while **Cupraganth® MV Activator** provides an alternative to palladium-based activation for IC substrates. Together, these technologies provide the robust process foundation required for increasingly complex electronics manufacturing.


**Electrolytic copper plating: Optimized for high-volume manufacturing**


In advanced PCB and substrate manufacturing, consistent plating performance at production scale is essential. MKS\` Atotech combines its production-proven **Inpulse®** chemistry portfolio with **Uniplate®** equipment to deliver highly controlled copper deposition processes that enhance yield, reduce variability, and ensure reliable feature filling across challenging designs Solutions including **Inpulse® 2HFU2, Inpulse® 2HT** , and the **Cuprapulse®** series provide superior conformal coverage, high throwing power and uniform copper distribution. **Inpulse® 2HF9** and **InPro® THF2** provide superior microvia filling and uniform copper distribution. For next generation package substrate build-up layers, **InPro® SAP7** provides best copper distribution at high current densities. The integrated approach of our Uniplate PLBCu lines helps manufacturers achieve the reliability, scalability, and process consistency required for next-generation AI, HPC, and advanced packaging applications.


**Final Finishing: Protecting performance through assembly and beyond**


The final surface finish plays a critical role in ensuring assembly success, long-term reliability, and overall manufacturing efficiency. MKS\` Atotech offers a comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading finishing technologies that protect copper from oxidation, maintain excellent solderability and bondability, and support increasingly fine-feature designs. The latest **Stannatech® 2100** and **Stannatech® IC** immersion tin solutions deliver enhanced solderability, lower ionic contamination, and compatibility with advanced substrate applications. For ENIG, ENEPIG, and EPAG processes, MKS combines **Aurotech® NIC** electroless nickel, **PD-Core®** electroless palladium, and **Aurotech® G-Bond 3** gold technologies to provide high-quality finishes with reduced precious metal consumption, short cycle times, and exceptional process robustness. These solutions help manufacturers maximize assembly yields while meeting the performance requirements of next-generation electronics.


**Systems solutions: Driving integrated systems precision at every stage**


PCB equipment system highlights include **G-Plate®,** a new high-volume manufacturing (HVM) platform for PTH processing of next-generation package substrates, enabling highest yields and supporting cutting-edge fine-line capability targeting L/S < 5/5 µm. The portfolio further includes **vPlate®,** a new vertical continuous plating system for advanced HDI, optical module, and package substrate applications, delivering best-in-class surface uniformity and optimized for mSAP pattern plating. **Uniplate®,** the company’s flagship HVM platform and industry-leading horizontal plating solution, serves next-generation HDI PCB, optical module, and package substrate manufacturing, including mSAP panel plating applications. Complementing these systems is the **Polygon PLBCu Line®,** engineered for superior blind microvia (BMV) filling and high aspect ratio through-hole (TH) plating, enabling robust HDI and MLB production and supporting demanding applications such as AI server boards.


Laser equipment promotions include the latest **Capstone™** , a high-performance/throughput breakthrough productivity for flex PCB UV drilling and **Geode™** platform (CO2 and UV laser for HDI and package substrate applications). A special show highlight **Geode™ A** a new CO2 laser system for high precision and high-speed ABF build-up laminate processing. **Geode™** **G2** the new CO2 laser system for high-precision and high-speed HDI and mSAP via drilling. The **Geode™** **platform** provides increased productivity, the smallest footprint, and the lowest power consumption in the market.


“We are proud to continue our partnership with IMPACT and host this year’s Industrial Forum, *‘Enabling AI and HPC: Technology Inflections Across Advanced Packaging and Interconnect.’* As AI infrastructure advances, we are focused on enabling next-generation chip packaging, package substrates, and high-performance interconnects. Across the IMPACT Conference and Tech x Total Solution Seminar, MKS’ strategic brands Atotech and ESI will showcase integrated process and equipment innovations that help customers meet the growing demands of AI-driven electronics manufacturing,” said **Wayne Cole,** Senior Vice President, Global Sales of Materials Solutions Division, MKS.


**IMPACT MKS’ Atotech Industrial Forum speakers, location, and time:** **Theme:** ***Surround the glass – Advanced packaging transition to glass core substrate***


Date: October 20; Time: 15:50 ~ 17:50
Venue: TaiNEX Hall 2, 7th floor, 701E
Session Chairs: Daniel Schmidt, Eddy Chen; Panel Q&A Moderator: Daniel


**Technical expertise at IMPACT 2026**


In parallel with the exhibition, MKS’ Atotech experts will contribute to the IMPACT Technical Forum with presentations covering advanced PCB manufacturing, package substrates, signal integrity, digital manufacturing and workforce enablement.
